title: Develop your goal muscles
html:
At this time of the year, we are all setting goals and getting ready to make some real progress.  If you did the exercise from last weeks MondayMotivator you probably have some big dreams that you can turn into goals. Most likely, you are filled with enthusiasm and energy and can't wait to achieve these big goals.

However, you might have set yourself up to fail. As the next few months roll on, you might fail on a few big goals, get disheartened, lose confidence and decide goal setting is not for you.

One way to overcome this is to develop your ‘goal muscles’. Like going to the gym for the first time, you can't jump in and bench 120kgs, you might injure yourself. You have to work your way up to it, developing your muscles and strength.

To develop your goal muscles, start off with small goals that you know you can achieve without much of a stretch; something like doing five star jumps every morning after you get out of bed. By achieving small goals, you will develop the confidence to take on bigger and bigger goals.

Have fun with this, as it will also help you develop the HABIT of achieving goals.
